White Rabbit combines time, frequency and phase measurement; this exercise only subtracts endpoint fixed delays from round trip then halves, while real systems also calibrate wavelength asymmetry. Map each quantity or event to an interface, then construct this synthetic input table: Synthetic round trip1000 ns with endpoint TX+RX fixed-delay aggregates100 and120 ns, counting all four fixed transmit/receive terms once. Revise the latter aggregate to160 ns while holding observed round trip fixed.
